properties.name: shredding.master-key
properties.description: Base64 master key that wraps every per-subject data key. Required, at least 32 bytes, supplied through the environment. No default and none is generated; sample-looking values are refused at startup.

properties.name: shredding.dev-mode
properties.description: Permits the in-memory key provider, which loses every data key on restart. Local development only; WARNs at every startup while on.

properties.name: shredding.allow-second-level-cache
properties.description: Permits a @Shredded entity to be second-level cached, accepting that a cached entity keeps serving the decrypted value after the key is destroyed.

properties.name: shredding.erased-value.policy
properties.description: What a read returns once the key is gone: sentinel, exception, or null. One policy per application. null WARNs at every startup.

properties.name: shredding.crypto.max-encryptions-per-key
properties.description: Values one data key may encrypt before it is rotated. Cannot be raised above 2^32.

properties.name: shredding.data-key-cache.ttl
properties.description: How long a node may hold an unwrapped data key. This is also how long a peer node can still read an erased subject's data after the erasure commits.

properties.name: shredding.data-key-cache.max-size
properties.description: How many unwrapped data keys a node may hold.

properties.name: shredding.erasure-log.hmac-secret
properties.description: HMAC secret for the erasure chain, at least 32 bytes. Required unless shredding.erasure-log.unkeyed=true. Never destroyed by an erasure, and never stored beside the datasource password.

properties.name: shredding.erasure-log.hmac-key-id
properties.description: Key id written inside the hashed material of every erasure record, so key rotation is data rather than a chain-format change.

properties.name: shredding.erasure-log.hmac-keys
properties.description: Every key id that may have signed a row, for verification across a rotation window.

properties.name: shredding.erasure-log.unkeyed
properties.description: Runs the erasure chain unkeyed, so its integrity rests only on database privilege separation. WARNs at every startup.

properties.name: shredding.blind-index.hmac-secret
properties.description: Secret for the blind index, at least 32 bytes. Required when the application declares any @BlindIndex column. Never the data key or the erasure-chain material.

properties.name: shredding.blind-index.bits
properties.description: Blind-index width. The index is a prefilter: the query path always re-verifies by decrypting.

properties.name: shredding.erasure.backup-retention
properties.description: How long backups, PITR archives and WAL keep a copy of the wrapped key. The erasure is complete only at erasedAt plus this, and the proof of erasure prints that date.
